mentions.note: Battery/solar play; stay away; if you buy, you never get out; avoid entirely.
Episodic, one of hardest stocks to own; Cramer ick.

Residential solar stock soared 2020-2021 on renewable energy adoption narrative; real driver was cheap financing availability, not solar fundamentals; when long-term rates elevated, thesis broke and stock crashed; lesson in understanding true investment thesis.

Residential solar stock surged 2020-2022 when borrowing was cheap, collapsed 2023 when rates rose; prime example of rally driven by financing availability (wrong reason) not fundamentals; losses inevitable when driver reverses.
